name: Miến lươn Hà Nội
prompt: Authentic studio food photography of traditional Hanoi eel glass noodles (Miến lươn Hà Nội). A steaming rustic ceramic bowl filled with translucent cellophane glass noodles, crispy golden deep-fried eel strips, tender braised eel fillet, fresh Vietnamese coriander (rau răm), laksa leaves, and thinly sliced scallions in a rich, clear aromatic dark amber eel broth. Placed on an aged dark wooden table with lime wedges, bird's eye chilies, crispy fried dough sticks (quẩy), soft morning natural lighting, steam rising, 4:3 aspect ratio, 8k resolution, food magazine editorial style.

name: Chả rươi Tứ Kỳ
prompt: Appetizing culinary food photography of authentic Tu Ky ragworm omelet patties (Chả rươi Tứ Kỳ). Golden crispy patties pan-fried to perfection, displaying finely minced pork, eggs, mandarin orange peel (vỏ quýt), dill, and green onions. Served on a woven bamboo plate lined with fresh green banana leaves, accompanied by fresh rice vermicelli, herbs, and a bowl of sweet-sour fish sauce with pickled green papaya and chili slices. Rustic wooden background, natural warm light, 4:3 aspect ratio, gourmet presentation.

name: Bánh đúc nóng Hà Nội
prompt: Close-up delicious food photography of hot Hanoi steamed rice cake (Bánh đúc nóng Hà Nội). A rustic stoneware bowl filled with silky, gooey hot rice dough topped with savory seasoned stir-fried minced pork, wood-ear mushrooms, golden crispy fried shallots, and fresh cilantro, ladled with steaming sweet-savory amber nuoc mam broth. Warm steam rising gently, placed on an old textured wooden table, cozy street food atmosphere, 4:3 aspect ratio, shallow depth of field.

name: Thịt đông dưa chua
prompt: Traditional Northern Vietnamese jellied meat with pickled mustard greens (Thịt đông dưa chua). Beautiful crystal-clear jellied pork aspic cake inverted on a ceramic plate, showing tender pork trotters, wood-ear mushrooms, and whole black peppercorns suspended inside the clear jelly. Accompanied by a side dish of vibrant yellow fermented pickled mustard greens (dưa cải muối chua) and a dipping bowl of pure fish sauce with black pepper. Warm festive lighting, wooden dining table, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Bún cá rô đồng
prompt: Authentic Vietnamese field perch fish noodle soup (Bún cá rô đồng Hải Dương). A large ceramic bowl with round white rice noodles, crispy deep-fried freshwater climbing perch fillets, tender boiled fish meat, green seasonal mustard greens (rau cải canh), and tomato wedges in a steaming, naturally sweet and savory golden fish bone broth. Garnished with fresh dill and scallions, wooden table setting with fresh herbs and sliced red chilies, 4:3 aspect ratio, high resolution.

name: Gỏi cá mai Nha Trang
prompt: Gourmet seafood presentation of Nha Trang deep-sea anchovy salad (Gỏi cá mai Nha Trang). Translucent fresh white fish fillets cured in lime juice, tossed with roasted peanuts, sesame seeds, thinly sliced onions, and fragrant mint herbs. Served with crisp rice paper, fresh perilla and lettuce, and a signature rich golden dipping sauce made from fish liver and roasted soy paste. Coastal sunlight on a dark wooden table, 4:3 aspect ratio, pristine culinary photography.

name: Hến xào xúc bánh tráng
prompt: Authentic Hue stir-fried baby basket clams with sesame rice crackers (Hến xào xúc bánh tráng). A warm earthenware plate filled with tiny river clams stir-fried with fragrant lemongrass, garlic, roasted peanuts, fried shallots, and spicy Vietnamese coriander (rau răm). Surrounded by large crispy grilled black sesame rice crackers (bánh tráng mè nướng) broken into wedges. Warm ambient light, rustic tabletop, 4:3 aspect ratio, appetizing food shot.

name: Bánh ướt thịt nướng Huế
prompt: Exquisite presentation of Hue steamed wet rice cake rolls with grilled pork (Bánh ướt thịt nướng Huế). Translucent delicate rice sheets neatly rolled with charcoal-grilled lemongrass marinated pork, fresh herbs, and lettuce. Neatly arranged on a dark green ceramic platter, accompanied by a small bowl of thick Hue hoisin-peanut dipping sauce (nước lèo tương đậu) with chili oil. Natural studio light, elegant Vietnamese gastronomy, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Lẩu cá bớp măng chua
prompt: Vibrant coastal Vietnamese cobia fish sour bamboo hotpot (Lẩu cá bớp măng chua). A bubbling hotpot burner with golden broth containing thick fresh cobia fish steaks, tender fermented sour bamboo shoots, red tomatoes, and fresh culantro. Beside it are plates of water spinach, banana blossoms, fresh rice noodles (bún), and chili fish sauce on a rustic beachside wooden table. Billowing steam, vibrant colors, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Bánh canh hẹ Phú Yên
prompt: Authentic Phu Yen chive thick noodle soup (Bánh canh hẹ Phú Yên). A traditional ceramic bowl filled with tapioca noodles and golden fried fish cake slices (chả cá chiên), completely smothered in a vibrant green layer of finely chopped fresh Asian chives (hẹ lá) floating on a clear, sweet simmered mackerel broth. Topped with a quail egg and fried shallots, steam rising, bright coastal morning light, 4:3 aspect ratio, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh đập mắm nêm Quảng Nam
prompt: Authentic Central Vietnamese smashed rice paper (Bánh đập mắm nêm Quảng Nam). A crispy grilled rice cracker melded together with a hot soft steamed rice sheet inside, brushed with glistening green scallion oil. Broken into crispy bite-sized sections on a banana-leaf lined bamboo tray, served with an aromatic bowl of spicy fermented anchovy sauce (mắm nêm) blended with minced pineapple, garlic, and fresh red chilies, 4:3 aspect ratio, rustic culinary styling.

name: Cơm gà Tam Kỳ
prompt: Iconic Tam Ky chicken rice plate (Cơm gà Tam Kỳ Quảng Nam). A bright golden-yellow turmeric chicken broth rice dome, topped with shredded free-range chicken tossed with Vietnamese coriander (rau răm), thinly sliced white onions, and lime pepper seasoning. Garnished with pickled shredded green papaya and served with a bowl of savory chicken soup and chili ginger sauce. Dark wooden table, artisanal ceramic ware, 4:3 aspect ratio, gourmet photography.

name: Cá lóc nướng trui miền Tây
prompt: Authentic Mekong Delta straw-roasted snakehead fish (Cá lóc nướng trui miền Tây). A whole freshwater snakehead fish roasted inside rice straw campfire, back split open revealing steaming moist snow-white fish meat brushed with scallion oil (mỡ hành) and crushed roasted peanuts. Served on a bamboo tray lined with banana leaves with wild river herbs, starfruit, green banana, rice vermicelli, rice paper, and a bowl of sweet-sour tamarind dipping sauce (mắm me), 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Hủ tiếu Sa Đéc
prompt: Famous Sa Dec dry noodle bowl (Hủ tiếu Sa Đéc khô). Chewy, translucent Sa Dec rice noodles tossed in a glossy signature brown sweet-savory sauce, topped with tender sliced pork loin, minced pork, boiled shrimp, pork liver, crispy pork cracklings (tóp mỡ), and fried garlic. Served with fresh chives, celery, and a separate bowl of clear simmering bone broth with spring onions, 4:3 aspect ratio, mouth-watering gourmet presentation.

name: Bánh cóng Sóc Trăng
prompt: Golden crispy Soc Trang cup cakes (Bánh cóng Sóc Trăng). Deep-fried tubular muffins with a blistered golden-brown crust, each crowned with a whole unpeeled sweet red river shrimp nestled on top. Cut in halves on a platter to show the fluffy interior filled with minced pork, mung beans, and jicama. Accompanied by a mountain of fresh mustard leaves, herbs, and sweet-sour garlic chili fish sauce, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Bún thịt nướng chả giò Sài Gòn
prompt: Appetizing Saigon grilled pork and egg roll noodle bowl (Bún thịt nướng chả giò Sài Gòn). A large white ceramic bowl of soft rice vermicelli topped with fragrant charcoal-grilled marinated pork slices, two crispy golden fried spring rolls sliced in diagonal halves, glistening scallion oil, roasted crushed peanuts, pickled daikon and carrots, fresh cucumber, and mint. Drizzled with sweet-tangy nuoc mam, 4:3 aspect ratio, studio culinary lighting.

name: Bánh xèo củ hũ dừa Bến Tre
prompt: Giant golden crispy Ben Tre coconut palm heart pancake (Bánh xèo củ hũ dừa Bến Tre). A large, thin, super-crispy yellow crepe folded over, loaded with tender sweet coconut palm heart (củ hũ dừa), wild river shrimp, minced pork, and bean sprouts. Served on a bamboo flat basket with wild Mekong Delta greens (lá lốt, đọt xoài, lá cóc), paired with a bowl of chili-garlic fish sauce with shredded radish, 4:3 aspect ratio, 8k resolution.

name: Cá kho tộ miền Tây
prompt: Traditional Southern Vietnamese caramelized catfish braised in a black clay pot (Cá kho tộ miền Tây). Thick center-cut fish steaks bubbling gently in an unglazed clay pot with an intense glistening dark caramel fish sauce glaze, tender pork belly chunks, whole bird's eye chilies, and cracked black pepper. Garnished with spring onions, steaming hot, served alongside fluffy white jasmine rice on a dark wooden table, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Cháo cá Tích Nghi
prompt: Authentic Bac Ninh carp fish porridge (Cháo cá Tích Nghi). A piping hot rustic ceramic bowl of smooth, velvety white rice congee cooked with sweet fish stock, topped with succulent pieces of freshwater carp stir-fried with fragrant dill (thì là), thinly sliced scallions, and fried shallots. Golden ginger strips and black pepper dusted over the top, steam rising, cozy traditional northern Vietnamese setting, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Bánh chưng Bờ Đậu
prompt: Famous Bo Dau square sticky rice cake (Bánh chưng Bờ Đậu Thái Nguyên). A pristine square cake wrapped in fragrant green dong leaves, sliced open cleanly to reveal deep emerald green glutinous rice, golden seasoned mung bean filling, and succulent marbled pork belly with fragrant black pepper. Placed on an antique wooden tray with pickled small scallions (củ kiệu muối), soft natural ambient light, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Thắng cố ngựa Đồng Văn
prompt: Authentic Dong Van horse meat stew (Thắng cố ngựa Đồng Văn Hà Giang). A steaming cast iron cauldron filled with rich highland stew featuring horse meat, tender offal, simmered with 12 traditional mountain forest herbs including star anise, cardamom, cinnamon, and mac khen pepper. Served in ceramic bowls on a pine wood table with chili salt paste, wild mountain greens, and corn wine in a highland market backdrop, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Xôi ngũ sắc Mù Cang Chải
prompt: Mu Cang Chai Five-Color Sticky Rice (Xôi ngũ sắc Mù Cang Chải Yên Bái). A round woven bamboo basket displaying glossy, steaming glutinous rice naturally dyed into 5 vibrant segments: purple (magenta leaf), red (gac fruit), yellow (turmeric/ginger), green (ginger leaf), and pure pearl white. Garnished with toasted sesame salt (muối mè) in a small wooden bowl, terrace field mountain atmosphere, natural sunlight, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Thịt trâu gác bếp Sơn La
prompt: Northwestern Vietnamese smoked dried buffalo meat (Thịt trâu gác bếp Sơn La). Strips of dark, smoke-cured buffalo meat shredded on a bamboo cutting board, revealing tender ruby-red fibrous meat inside, coated with wild forest mac khen seeds and dried chili flakes. Served with a dipping bowl of traditional chẩm chéo mountain herb salt paste and lime wedges, cozy kitchen hearth background, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Cháo canh cá lóc Quảng Bình
prompt: Quang Binh snakehead fish noodle soup (Cháo canh cá lóc Quảng Bình). A deep ceramic bowl filled with thick, soft wheat and tapioca noodles, loaded with golden pan-seared snakehead fish fillets seasoned with turmeric and shallots, simmered in a rich sweet fish bone broth. Garnished with shredded green bitter leaves (rau cải xanh thái nhỏ) and crispy fried shallots, steam billowing, authentic central Vietnamese table, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Cơm gà Phan Rang
prompt: Phan Rang traditional chicken rice (Cơm gà Phan Rang Ninh Thuận). A platter of golden chicken rice cooked in rich chicken broth, served with a plate of chopped boiled free-range chicken with glossy golden skin and firm meat. Accompanied by four iconic dipping sauces (ginger fish sauce, salt-pepper-lime, crushed bird's eye chili paste, and sour garlic sauce) with fresh laksa leaves and sliced cucumber, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Bánh căn Phan Thiết
prompt: Phan Thiet mini rice pancakes (Bánh căn Phan Thiết). Small round crispy white rice cakes baked in terracotta molds, paired in couples with green scallion oil. Served with a large bowl of warm rich dipping broth containing braised pork meatballs (xíu mại), boiled quail eggs, shredded green mango, pork cracklings, and spicy red chili paste, coastal sunlight, 4:3 aspect ratio, 8k resolution.

name: Gỏi lá Kon Tum
prompt: Kon Tum wild forest leaf salad wrap (Gỏi lá Kon Tum). A massive rustic platter overflowing with over 30 varieties of fresh mountain wild leaves and herbs. In the center are platters of thinly sliced boiled pork belly, steamed river shrimp, pork skin carpaccio (bì lợn), and a warm earthenware bowl of fermented glutinous rice and shrimp paste dipping sauce. Central Highlands wooden table, authentic ethnic culinary art, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Phở khô Gia Lai
prompt: Gia Lai two-bowl dry pho (Phở khô hai tô Gia Lai). Set of two ceramic bowls: One bowl of thin springy dry pho noodles tossed in dark fermented soy bean sauce (tương nâu), topped with seasoned minced pork, crispy shallots, and celery. The second bowl filled with steaming hot, clear rich beef bone broth with tender sliced rare beef and meatballs, fresh herbs on the side, 4:3 aspect ratio, studio photography.

name: Bánh khọt Vũng Tàu
prompt: Crispy Vung Tau mini shrimp pancakes (Bánh khọt Vũng Tàu). Sizzling round mini golden pancakes with crunchy ruffled edges, each topped with a whole fresh pink sea shrimp, sprinkled with savory dried shrimp powder and green scallion oil. Served on a ceramic platter with a huge basket of leafy greens, mustard leaves, shredded green papaya, and garlic chili dipping fish sauce, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Bánh tráng phơi sương cuốn thịt luộc Trảng Bàng
prompt: Authentic Trang Bang dew-soaked rice paper rolls with boiled pork (Bánh tráng phơi sương cuốn thịt luộc Trảng Bàng Tây Ninh). Flexible, slightly salty sun-dried and dew-wetted rice paper rounds, served alongside a platter of thinly sliced boiled pork belly with double fat borders, a huge assortment of forest herbs and sour vegetables, and a bowl of fragrant fermented anchovy dipping sauce (mắm nêm) with minced chili and garlic, 4:3 aspect ratio.

name: Cá tai tượng chiên xù Vĩnh Long
prompt: Spectacular Mekong Delta deep-fried giant gourami fish standing upright on a wooden rack (Cá tai tượng chiên xù Vĩnh Long). Whole fish deep-fried to a majestic golden crisp with scales ruffled and standing erect like lace. Served with rice paper, fresh cucumber, starfruit, wild herbs, and a bowl of sweet-sour chili fish sauce, authentic Southern Vietnamese feast, 4:3 aspect ratio, 8k resolution.

name: Bún nước lèo Trà Vinh
prompt: Tra Vinh Khmer fermented fish noodle soup (Bún nước lèo Trà Vinh). A steaming ceramic bowl of rice noodles topped with flaky boiled snakehead fish fillets, sweet boiled river shrimp, crispy roasted pork belly chunks (heo quay), and fresh shredded water spinach and banana blossoms, in an aromatic clear broth infused with prahok fermented fish and wild ginger (củ ngải bún). Steaming hot, vibrant colors, 4:3 aspect ratio.
